{"consolidated_memory":"## ml/serving/batcher.py Latency Spikes – Two Separate Incidents

**File:** ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side)
**Covering test:** tests/ml/test_batcher.py
**Stack:** Python

---

### INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-04] Connection Pool Exhaustion

**Problem:** Latency spike in the batcher
**Repro:** Send the mixed-size request trace
**Signal:** Tail far above the median in the serving histogram
**Trigger:** Occurred only when two requests raced on the same key
**Root cause:** Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
**Fix:** Raised the pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue in front of it
**PR:** #6155 on branch fix/latency-spike-1
**Outcome:** Backlog cleared 4 minutes after deploy

---

### INCIDENT 2: [2026-07-24] Floating Point Rounding Error

**Problem:** Latency spike in the batcher
**Repro:** Send the mixed-size request trace
**Signal:** Tail far above the median in the serving histogram
**Trigger:** Occurred only for records carrying non-ASCII names
**Root cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
**Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
**PR:** #7542 on branch fix/latency-spike-2
**Outcome:** p99 latency fell from 4.6 s to 136 ms"}
